your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Turn 0, $1500 cash, landed on Vermont ($100). Buying is correct — cheap light-blue foothold, keeps cash healthy at $1400, starts a monopoly path. No reason to auction and let opponents get it cheap.
Just bought Vermont. No one else owns anything, so trading is pointless and mortgaging a fresh $100 property with $1400 cash is wasteful. End turn and keep cash for better buys.

Landed on St. James ($180, orange). Oranges are the best ROI group (jail adjacency). $1400 cash, buy leaves $1220 — still liquid for later buys. I own Vermont only, no group conflict. Buying is clearly better than auctioning a strong property to three opponents with $1500 each.
